g.text: From the 11:05 access-control changeto the first bypass at 13:05
Deployment reaches customer environments; first errors observed on customer HTTP traffic.
First automated test detects the issue; manual investigation starts at 11:32 and theincident call is created at 11:35.

Through 13:05 the team investigates elevated traffic levels and errors to Workers KV. The initialsymptom appeared to be a degraded Workers KV response rate causing downstream impact on otherCloudflare services. Traffic manipulation and account limiting were attempted.
Workers KV and Cloudflare Access bypass implemented and impact reduced: internal systembypasses fell back to a prior version of the core proxy.
1 h 37 min from the first customer errors at 11:28 to the first bypass at 13:05 — derived from the published timestamps.
Cloudflare, “Cloudflare outage on November 18, 2025”, incident timeline. Severity bands are this review’s reading of the published status column.
